title: High-touch intake operational playbook and release scaling for priority partners
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create an operational playbook and release-scaling protocol for high-touch partner intake and escalations. This ticket defines the decision rules, SLA gates, capacity hedges, and a lightweight template for converting customer asks into scoped roadmap work that can be consistently prioritized across cycles.
background: We currently handle top-account escalations ad hoc. Sales and customer success escalate high-impact asks into product, but intake lacks consistent SLOs, risk signals, or a repeatable fast-track that respects engineering capacity. This causes missed expectations, untracked scope creep, and instability in quarterly commitments.
goals: Define a 4-tier intake rubric (Triage / Advocate / Fastpass / Commit) with clear criteria
Create a 15-minute 'Rapid Intake' template for AE/Sales to capture scope and urgency
Specify release-scaling rules and sprint-slice guidelines for partial deliveries
Integrate intake signals into roadmap cadence and OKR reporting
success_metrics: Reduce average intake-to-decision time for top-account asks from 12 business days to 3
Decrease slipping roadmap commitments attributed to unscoped escalations by 40%
Achieve >90% stakeholder satisfaction on resolution clarity in post-mortem surveys
acceptance_criteria: Operational playbook document published to Confluence with versioning and owner
Two training sessions scheduled: CS+Sales and Product+Eng operational drills
Dashboard tile added: intake volume by tier, time-to-decision, and downstream sprints impacted
Canary run: onboard 2 live escalations through the playbook without manual rework
tasks: Draft playbook: decision gates, evidence needed, cross-team approval matrix
Build 'Rapid Intake' Google Form and standardize triage fields
Add tagging to roadmap board for 'high-touch' and instrument capacity forecast impact
Work with Eng to define sprint-slice templates and minimum shippable increments
Create Confluence page and link to product PRD template
Schedule and run 2 pilot intake drills with AE and CS teams
Instrument a dashboard in Metabase for intake KPIs
Ship a small console UI change to expose intake ticket IDs to engineers (ENG-20145)
Collect pilot feedback and iterate playbook
risks: Playbook too heavyweight -> teams bypass it for urgent asks
Engineering capacity estimates underestimated, causing broken promises
CS/Sales adoption friction if forms add perceived bureaucracy
Ambiguous tiers lead to inconsistent prioritization across AMs

decisions: Adopt 4-tier rubric; tiers incorporate customer revenue signal, regulatory constraints, and technical feasibility
Use 2-day SLA for 'time-to-decision' on Fastpass tier, 10-day SLA for Advocate tier
Allow partial delivery (sprint-slice) commitments with documented rollback and follow-up deliverables
Pilot will be limited to NA accounts to reduce region-specific complexity
